summary: Discovery becomes one simple list you can act on in a click, and commits are no longer reported as failures while they roll out.

new.title: Discovery is one list: Create or Ignore
new.text: Discovery lists what is in your tenant but not yet in PIM Manager. Create or Ignore one item, several, or a whole kind in one click.

new.title: Create stages a permission group
new.text: Create turns an Azure scope or Power BI workspace into a permission group named by your convention, ready in Review & commit. Nothing is granted to anyone.

new.title: See and re-add ignored items
new.text: The Ignored view lists ignored items with who ignored them and when, and Re-add brings one back.

fixes.title: No alerts while a commit rolls out
fixes.text: For 45 minutes after a change, a failed run or drift is not emailed, giving the commit time to finish. Changes waiting for your approval are still reported at once.

fixes.title: Duplicate Defender XDR roles are removed
fixes.text: Duplicate Defender XDR roles are now removed on the next run, also when a group is already bound to one of the copies.
